nis_to_org_evidence.13990: Register name 'ERIPOTO FOR GIRLS AND WOMEN' (registered 2022-01-21, district Arusha) is the name on the organisation's own Facebook page and site header ('Eripoto for girls & women'); its site says it was founded in 2022 (checked 2026-10-10).
nis_to_org_evidence.14690: Register name 'KUKUA PAMOJA TANZANIA' (00NGO/R/3308, registered 2022-05-18, district Arusha) is the name on the organisation's own Idealist profile; both publish the same vision and mission sentences. The classifier's 'unlikely' (medium_projects_only: only its project list names children) is overridden by review: the Idealist profile publishes the Fill the Gap Sponsorship Program for children aged 2-25 (kindergarten to university) and the register lists a 'Child Education Sponsorship Program' (2022). Sources: https://www.idealist.org/en/nonprofit/1167dd4b6c1542bb894840e5f58fe6b2-kukua-pamoja-tanzania-arusha and https://nis.jamii.go.tz/ngo_profile/14690 (both read 2026-10-11).
